games.name: [2 Player] Guess The Person
games.desc:
❗How to play Guess the Person 
Take turns asking questions. "Is it a man?" "Do they have brown hair?" You only press buttons. No typing.
Your opponent answers Yes or No. Then you look at THEIR board and flip down every face that cannot be it.
When one face is left on their board, guess it. The match does not end there. Your opponent gets time to make their guess too. Then both guesses are shown at the same time. You can BOTH be right.

👑 You get crowns when you win. Use crowns to buy win emotes - a dance your character does on the win screen, so the other player sees it.
🤖 Nobody to play with? Press Play Alone. A bot sits in the other seat and plays a real match.
⭐ How to play

1. Sit on a chair in the lobby
2. Pick your secret face
3. Ask, answer, flip
4. Guess their face before they guess yours

games.name: The Battle Bricks
games.desc:
[UPDATE - CHAPTER 5]: Undead Cation, a brand new challenging chapter along with overhauls and quality of life changes for the majority of the game.

The Battle Bricks is a single-player tower defense styled game where you send units to defeat enemy bases to progress through stages! Although, the enemies will send units to attack back! Discover the seemingly countless amount of units along the way with varying purposes and upgrade them enough to see their alternative forms! Each stage and chapter will make you face new enemies, bases, bosses, or even how stages are handled to challenge your skills and strategies. A linear game that you can pick up from any time!

And... there's something to uncover if you ever want to have a feeling that's difficult to describe ...?
